TOPIC 9.9
Finding the Area of 
the Region Bounded 
by Two Polar Curves

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

CHA-5.D 
Calculate areas of regions 
defined by polar curves using 
definite integrals. bc only

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

CHA-5.D.2 
Areas of regions bounded by polar curves can 
be calculated with definite integrals. bc only

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

CHA-5
Definite integrals allow us to solve problems involving the accumulation of change in 
area or volume over an interval.
